learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: 20 variable products (10 flavours x 'Holiday H-Bar <Flavour> THC Vape' and 'Holiday H-Bar Plus <Flavour> 2G THC Vape'), 3 variations each.
notes: Both parents of a flavour carry the same three variations (Device / Capacity as slugs: 'h-bar / 0-5g', 'h-bar / 1g', 'h-bar-plus / 2g'), with different ids. The H-Bar parent keeps its 0.5g and 1g, the H-Bar Plus parent its 2g; the repeats are skipped.
'0-5g' is a slug for 0.5g and would read as 5g, so that variation's size is set; 1g and 2g read from the variant.

The same ten flavours serve Massachusetts, New York and New Jersey ('No matter which of the three states you're in', home page); there is no state filter. NY COAs are a Google Drive folder. Collabs (STAYME70 x Holiday, NY only; TYSON 2.0 x Holiday) have their own pages and are not in the Store API.
prices are 0 (no online sales); every H-Bar is an all-in-one.
On 2026-10-05 stores sold 10 products (2+ stores); 9 are here. 'Flapjacks' 1g is on no page of the site (not a lineup flavour, not named on the collab pages).
